biggest_catch: You don't control your pay rate — the company posting the job sets it, and you get paid the day AFTER the job, not same-day.
catches: Pay is set by the requesting company, not by you; rates vary widely by job type and market.
Payment is issued the day after the job is complete AND the employer rates your performance — a bad rating can affect payment/timing.
You must pass screening (app quiz, onboarding call, background check) before accepting jobs.
Jobs are independent-contractor shifts (no overtime, no benefits); shift availability is market-dependent.

c1.evidence: Wonolo's own blog (info.wonolo.com): 'Wonoloers (Wonolo workers) are paid daily and payments are usually issued the day after the job has been completed. Wonolo's payment system offers the options of payment by check or direct deposit.'

c2.evidence: Official info.wonolo.com: 'At Wonolo, companies decide how much to pay their temporary workers, and the service fee is added to the company's invoice after shifts are complete - not taken out of workers' pay.' Each job posting shows its pay rate before you accept; no fixed official range.

c3.evidence: No fee to join in official materials.

c4.evidence: Official: 'Wonolo pays its workers (Wonoloers) daily, issuing payments the day after a job is complete and the employer rates the Wonoloer's performance.' Day-after-job payout via direct deposit or check.

steps: Download the Wonolo app and complete onboarding (profile, aptitude quiz, onboarding call, background check).
Browse and accept available jobs; each posting shows the pay rate before you accept.
Work the shift and get rated by the employer on completion.
Wonolo issues payment the day after the job is complete.
Receive pay via direct deposit (or check).
timing: Paid daily — payment issued the day after the job is complete and the employer rates your performance (direct deposit or check).
who_pays: The company posting the shift pays you — the rate is set by them, and Wonolo adds its service fee to the company's invoice rather than taking it from your pay.
who_qualifies: 18+; ID plus a background check; onboarding through the smartphone app (quiz plus a call); in Wonolo metro markets.
work_available: Shift availability is market-dependent — jobs are independent-contractor shifts posted in the app, and how much work you see depends on your metro.
what_gets_accepted: The employer must rate your performance after the job, and payment is issued the day after the job is complete — a bad rating can affect your payment and timing.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees. Unpaid time: the screening process (app quiz, onboarding call, background check) before you can accept any job.
when_cash_arrives: Paid daily — payment is issued the day after the job is complete, via direct deposit or check.

repeatable.cadence: New jobs post daily — complete a job, get paid the next day, and claim the next one.
